title: Chatarung
overview: A full-stack chess engine with full move validation, piece logic, and special rules. Currently in the process of creating the chess engine
description: Full-stack chess engine built in Spring Boot and Angular with board, state, piece movement logic and validation, and special rules. Used DSA, OOP, and SOLID principles to build. Currently building the chess engine to have deep analysis and a chess bot to play against, as well as building a multiplayer feature.
features: Special rules implementation such as en passant, castling, and pawn promotion
Notations generated after each move for move history and will add an undo button
challenges: Creating pawn promotion dialog to pop up and maintaining proper turn state
Enforcing En Passant rule to only be available for that specific turn in that situation
Avoiding a circular dependency between Move Generation and Check Generation

title: Library Management System
overview: A terminal based library management system built with Java.
description: A pure Java backend app emphasizing OOP principles, encapsulation, and Java Collections to handle CRUD database logic.
features: Dynamic CRUD operations for books and borrowers data profiles
Query searching mechanisms to filter find available books
State tracking logic to manage borrowing and return transactions
Interactive command line control flow utilizing structured switch navigation modules
challenges: Designing an in-memory data pipeline using efficient Java Collections structures to maintain runtime data integrity without a relational database.

title: Whisk
overview: A secure full-stack ecommerce engine utilizing JWT authentication systems, persistent MongoDB, and a simulated PayPal checkout.
description: A secure full-stack ecommerce engine utilizing JWT authentication systems, persistent MongoDB, and a simulated PayPal checkout. (Please allow a few seconds for the netlify server to load)
features: Secured application ednpoints via token-based JWT Authentication and states logic
Architected complex data model that can handle products, shopping carts, and checkout.
Integrated third-party APIs including Cloudinary for asset management and a simulated PayPal Sandbox processing
Engineered an administrative dashboard for product handling and adding

title: Horizon
overview: An asynchronous TypeScript and Angular engine designed to efficiently parse, structure, and render payload streams from OpenWeather RESTful API.
description: An asynchronous TypeScript and Angular engine designed to efficiently parse, structure, and render payload streams from OpenWeather RESTful API.
features: Engineered an asynchronous data-parsing logic block consuming OpenWeather API configurations
Constructed isolated layout components mapping localized daily, hourly, and weekly weather metrics
Implemented strict fallback UI blocks and catch-block validations to handle API latency drops
Designed dynamic template state bindings allowing seamless metrics scaling toggles
challenges: Managing asynchronous weather data payloads and handling UI loading or error states smoothly during API latency drops.
